name: Ducati Panigale 959 / V2
engine: 955 cc liquid-cooled Superquadro L-twin, fuel injected
intro: Ducati's middleweight superbike. A few small recalls, mostly lighting and brakes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2018 959s are in recall 18V480 (rear brake pad friction material). 2020-2023 Panigale V2s are in recall 23V377 (headlight can switch to the DRL at night). Some 2025 V2s are in recall 25V838 (wiring fault that can lock a wheel).

recalls.what: Rear brake pad friction material may come off the backing plate.
Dashboard software can switch from low beam to the daytime running light at night.
recalls.fix: Dealer updates the dashboard software free.

recalls.what: Fuse and wiring fault that can lock the front or rear wheel.
